{{short description|Spanish physicist}}
'''Oriol Bohigas i Martí''' (22 December 1937 – 22 October 2013) was a Spanish and French [[physicist]].
[[Image:OriolBohigas.jpg|thumb|280px|Oriol Bohigas i Martí, July 17, 1998]]

Bohigas was born in [[Barcelona]], where he studied [[physics]] at the [[University of Barcelona|university]].  In 1966 he became researcher at France's [[CNRS]], where he would stay until the end of his career, becoming Director of Research Emeritus at the LPTMS laboratory ([[Laboratoire de physique théorique et modèles statistiques|Laboratoire de Physique Théorique et Modèles Statistiques]]), of which he was one of the founders, at Université de Paris-Sud in Orsay. Before that, he had been head of the Division of Theoretical Physics of the Institute of Nuclear Physics (IPN), on the campus of the same university.<ref name="RevFisica">{{citation |url=http://publicacions.iec.cat/PopulaFitxa.do?moduleName=revistes_cientifiques&subModuleName=&idColleccio=3 |title=Oriol Bohigas Martí (1937–2013) |last=Martorell |first=Joan |journal=[[Revísta de Física]] |volume=4 |number=10 |pages=39–40 |year=2013 |issn=1131-5326 |publisher=[[Societat Catalana de Física]] |language=Catalan }}</ref><ref name="scf">{{citation |url=http://blogs.iec.cat/scfis/ |title=Mort del físic català Oriol Bohigas i Martí |accessdate=2013-10-30 |editor=[[Societat Catalana de Física]] |editor2=[[Institut d'Estudis Catalans]] |language=Catalan }}</ref><ref name="lptms">{{citation |url=http://lptms.u-psud.fr |title=Laboratoire de Physique Théorique et Modèles Statistiques (LPTMS) |accessdate=2013-10-28 |publisher=Université Paris-Sud |language=French }}</ref><ref name="elpais">{{citation |url=http://sociedad.elpais.com/sociedad/2013/10/28/actualidad/1382996867_163920.html  |title= Oriol Bohigas Martí |accessdate=2013-10-29 |last1=Navarro |first1=J |last2=Poves |first2=A |language=Spanish|journal=[[El País]] |page=45 |date=2013-10-29}}</ref>  He died in [[Orsay]].

His fundamental contributions to the theory of [[quantum chaos]] and its applications, particularly in [[nuclear physics]], granted him the [[Gay-Lussac]]-[[Alexander von Humboldt|Humboldt]] Prize (1991),<ref name="humboldt">{{citation |url=http://cache.media.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/file/2013/18/7/listelaureats_239187.pdf |title=Liste des lauréats du prix Gay-Lussac Humboldt depuis sa création |editor=Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche |language=French |accessdate=2013-10-29 |archive-date=2016-03-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303233118/http://cache.media.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/file/2013/18/7/listelaureats_239187.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> the [[Fernand Holweck Medal and Prize|Holweck Medal]] (1999),<ref name="holweck">{{citation |url=http://sfp.in2p3.fr/Prix/prix.html |title=Les prix de la SFP |editor=Société Française de Physique |language=French |accessdate=2013-10-29}}</ref> and an ''honoris causa'' doctorate by the [[Technical University of Darmstadt|Technische Universität Darmstadt]],<ref name="damrs">{{citation |doi=10.1080/10506890208232666 |first=A. |last=Richter |title=Honorary doctorate for Oriol Bohigas |journal=Nuclear Physics News |volume=12 |number=2 |page=30 |year=2002 |s2cid=124872860 }}</ref> among other recognitions.<ref name="scf"/><ref name="lptms"/><ref name="elpais"/>
